fields.description: Issue includes extensive political commentary and advocacy related to repeal/local-option voting in Dade County, including discussion of Miami Beach politics and alleged crime and corruption. Content also covers local nightlife and entertainment venues, radio program schedules, letters to the editor, and advertisements; sports and leisure items include horse-racing tips and promotion of wrestling and auto races.
